hooks.command: if command -v make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -n lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '--- Auto-lint after edit ---' && make lint 2>&1 | tail -30; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qvE '\.(claude|github)/|CODEBASE\.md|KNOWN_ISSUES\.md'; then echo "REMINDER: You created $file — update .claude/CODEBASE.md if this is a new module, component, route, or lib file."; fi

cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force|rm -rf /|git reset --hard|git checkout -- \.|DROP TABLE|truncate.*production'; then echo "BLOCKED: Potentially destructive command detected. Confirm with user before proceeding."; exit 2; fi
